Things like your department, manager, office location, or employee ID would be useful to have on hand.

Good point. One thing I know is that my six-month probation period ends with a formal review. I'll get the exact review date confirmed soon but I know the duration is six months from my start.

I want to make sure her name is recorded because she'll be the one conducting my probation review and signing off on my project assignments going forward.
